name: Amiodarone

moa.t: Prolongs repolarisation (potassium-channel block) with sodium-channel, calcium-channel and β-blocking effects, very long half-life

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Amiodarone, oral, 200 mg 8 hourly for 1 week. Specialist initiated. · Followed by 200 mg 12 hourly for one week. · Thereafter, 200 mg daily.
Amiodarone, IV, 5 mg/kg infused over 30 minutes.
Amiodarone, oral, 200 mg 8 hourly for 7 days. · Then, 200 mg 12 hourly for 7 days. · Maintenance dose: 200 mg daily for the minimum time required to
Amiodarone, oral, 200 mg three times a day for 7 days. · Then 200 mg 12 hourly for 7 days. · Follow with a maintenance dose of 200–400 mg daily, depending
Amiodarone, IV bolus, 300 mg, 2 minutes after adrenaline (epinephrine) dose. · Follow by a bolus of 10 mL sterile water or sodium chloride 0.9%.
Amiodarone, oral, 800 mg daily for 7 days. · Then 600 mg daily for 3 days. · Hypotension may occur, especially during the loading dose phase
Amiodarone, IV, 5 mg/kg slowly over 20 minutes. AND Continue with DC cardioversion.

contraindications.t: Sinus bradycardia or heart block without pacing

cautions.t: Give via a large or central vein in dextrose 5%

adverse_effects.t: Hypotension and bradycardia with IV, phlebitis, thyroid dysfunction, pulmonary fibrosis, hepatitis, corneal deposits, photosensitivity with long-term use, QT prolongation

monitoring.t: ECG, BP, thyroid and liver function long term
